pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1
sql_duckdb: WITH attendance_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(t23.Centre, t24.centre_name) AS Centre, COALESCE(t23.Month, t24.month) AS Month, CAST(t23."Avg Daily Present" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t23."Enrolled Kids", 0), 0) * 100 AS pct_2023, CAST(t24.average_attendance AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t24.enrolment, 0), 0) * 100 AS pct_2024 FROM attendance_2023 AS t23 FULL OUTER JOIN attendance_2024 AS t24 ON t23.Centre = t24.centre_name AND t23.Month = t24.month) SELECT Centre, Month, pct_2023, pct_2024, pct_2024 - pct_2023 AS pct_point_change FROM attendance_stats ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t23.Centre, t24.centre_name) AS Centre,
    COALESCE(t23.Month, t24.month) AS Month,
    CAST(t23."Avg Daily Present" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t23."Enrolled Kids", 0) * 100 AS pct_2023,
    CAST(t24.average_attendance AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t24.enrolment, 0) * 100 AS pct_2024
  FROM attendance_2023 t23
  FULL OUTER JOIN attendance_2024 t24
    ON t23.Centre = t24.centre_name
    AND t23.Month = t24.month
)
SELECT
  Centre,
  Month,
  pct_2023,
  pct_2024,
  pct_2024 - pct_2023 AS pct_point_change
FROM attendance_stats
ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
